t: A desktop robot dog that runs Linux and ROS 2 for learning real robotics.
steps: Buy the pre-assembled kit from the MangDang store or a robot shop.
Flash Ubuntu 22.04 server to a microSD card.
Set your Wi-Fi details and boot the dog.
Clone the mini_pupper_2_bsp repo and run its install script.
Run the calibrate tool and line up each leg.
Make the dog stand and walk, then steer it from your laptop.
Install the mini_pupper_ros packages and try the ROS 2 examples.
meta: Open Code. From $399. A few stores.
